title: Repair C17 bundle-root self-referential hash defect; implement authoritative generic identities, explicit manifest ACT-local, acyclic bundle root, and production-bound integration tests without rewriting F17 or S17 and without beginning Wave 1

baseline.F18: this plan-freeze commit; parent(F18) = S17; contains this plan and no other path
baseline.S18: exactly one model-authored subject commit; parent(S18) = F18

known_correction17_authority_defects.bundle_root_self_referential_hash: The C17 bundle-root.json records its own SHA-256 as a473591e... but the actual file content computes to ef17fe26... This is a self-referential hash failure: the bundle-root cannot claim a hash of itself that doesn't match.
known_correction17_authority_defects.classification_lifecycle_violation: C17 final-classification.md was potentially rewritten after bundle-root.json creation in some lifecycle traces; Phase 6 requires classification BEFORE root exists.
known_correction17_authority_defects.act_local_manifest_not_enforced: C17 verify_all.sh --act-local accepts --base/--subject but may not enforce that the manifest is passed; Phase 3 requires explicit manifest interface.
known_correction17_authority_defects.gate_invocation_environment_implicit_inh: C17 GateInvocation records may inherit environment implicitly; Phase 2 requires explicit environment in records.
known_correction17_authority_defects.ruff_equivalence_field_names_correction_: C17 uses correction-specific field names; Phase 2 requires generic identities.

transaction_topology.F18: this plan-freeze commit; parent(F18) = S17 (2e920bb5); contains this plan and no other path
transaction_topology.S18: exactly one model-authored subject commit; parent(S18) = F18
transaction_topology.C: absent until a qualified Leamas v2 implementation produces it; never model-authored
transaction_topology.T: absent until Leamas v2 produces it; never model-authored
transaction_topology.E: absent until Leamas v2 produces protocol E; the manual evidence bundle and publication-result are not protocol E

phase_2_generic_identities.description: Phase 2 replaces correction-number-specific field names with generic identities throughout the gate plan
phase_2_generic_identities.freeze_commit: The plan-freeze commit OID (was F17, F16, etc.)
phase_2_generic_identities.freeze_tree: The tree hash of the freeze commit
phase_2_generic_identities.freeze_parent: The parent OID of the freeze commit
phase_2_generic_identities.plan_blob: The blob hash of the plan file in the freeze commit
phase_2_generic_identities.subject_commit: The subject commit OID (was S17, S16, etc.)
phase_2_generic_identities.subject_tree: The tree hash of the subject commit
phase_2_generic_identities.subject_parent: The parent OID of the subject commit (should equal freeze_commit)

required_fields: cwd: str - working directory at execution
environment: dict[str, str] - explicit environment (no implicit inheritance)
input_paths: tuple[str, ...] - files consumed by the gate
GateInvocation_contract.forbidden: No required environment input may be inherited implicitly

phase_3_explicit_manifest.description: Phase 3 requires ACT-local to receive an explicit immutable manifest file
phase_3_explicit_manifest.ACT_local_must_not_git_discovery: In explicit range mode ACT-local MUST NOT invoke git diff, git status, git ls-files, or any other Git discovery command
phase_3_explicit_manifest.manifest_authority: The orchestrator-produced changed-paths.z is the SOLE source of changed files in explicit range mode
phase_3_explicit_manifest.manifest_immutable: The manifest file is written once before gate execution and never modified

phase_4_exact_gate_inventories.description: Phase 4 builds each gate inventory from the actual planned argv
phase_4_exact_gate_inventories.inventory_contract: Byte-for-byte equality between each recorded manifest and the corresponding executed gate input tuple
phase_4_exact_gate_inventories.ruff_gate_must_use_exact_S18_tuple: The Ruff gate executes against the exact S18 changed-Python path tuple, not a glob
phase_4_exact_gate_inventories.range_hygiene_gate: git diff --check <F18_FULL_OID> <S18_FULL_OID> - must use the full resolved OIDs

phase_5_real_ruff_equivalence.description: Phase 5 executes explicit and canonical Ruff commands as two typed ExecutedCommand records

explicit_command.ordered_input_tuple_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted input path tuple

phase_5_real_ruff_equivalence.canonical_command: Same fields as explicit_command, but without --config flag
phase_5_real_ruff_equivalence.forbidden: Self-comparisons (e.g., x == x) are NOT permitted; each field must be independently measured

phase_6_acyclic_bundle_root.description: Phase 6 renders final-classification.md EXACTLY ONCE before bundle-root.json exists
algorithm: 1. Write all non-root artifacts to staging
2. Render final-classification.md with PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESULT for bundle_root_sha256 and publication_succeeded
3. Hash every final non-root file from disk
5. Parse the root back from disk
6. Rehash every path from the root's own 'files' mapping
7. Require zero missing, extra, or mismatched files
8. NEVER modify an in-bundle file after this point
phase_6_acyclic_bundle_root.acyclic_guarantee: final-classification.md is rendered BEFORE bundle-root.json exists; bundle-root.json is NOT an input to classification

phase_7_fail_closed_publication.description: Phase 7 implements fail-closed publication with pre-checks
phase_7_fail_closed_publication.staging_creation: staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False) - must fail if directory exists
phase_7_fail_closed_publication.post_rename_rehash: After rename, rehash the complete published directory
phase_7_fail_closed_publication.rehash_error_handling: Any rehash error must make the publication result fail and the CLI exit nonzero
phase_7_fail_closed_publication.forbidden: Never convert an exception into an empty successful hash mapping

phase_8_production_bound_integration_tes.description: Phase 8 requires production-bound integration tests that call the real CLI and inspect artifacts

required_mutation_tests.mutation: alter final classification after root creation

test_requirements.required: Tests must call the real CLI and inspect produced artifacts

executed_command_contract.type: @dataclass(frozen=True) class ExecutedCommand: name: str; argv: tuple[str, ...]; cwd: str; returncode: int; stdout: bytes; stderr: bytes; status: Literal['passed', 'failed', 'skipped']; stdout_sha256 and stderr_sha256 are properties derived from the raw bytes
executed_command_contract.serialized_form: Raw bytes remain authoritative in memory; JSON records their SHA-256 values and may reference separately persisted raw output files.
executed_command_contract.range_error: RangeResolutionError.stderr contains decoded command stderr, never its digest.

single_git_seam_contract.spy_proof: Patch subprocess.run and fail any invocation outside the injected Git command seam.

repository_gate_contract.type: @dataclass(frozen=True) class RepositoryGateResult: name: Literal[semantic names]; command: ExecutedCommand
repository_gate_contract.execution: The evidence driver executes every required gate before publication and passes the resulting typed records directly to bundle construction. All seven gates must pass (returncode=0 and status='passed').
repository_gate_contract.failure_behavior: When any required gate fails, the staging directory is removed, the publication result is marked failed, no bundle is published, and the process exits nonzero.
repository_gate_contract.act_local_range_supply: The act-local-range gate is invoked as ./scripts/verify_all.sh --act-local --base F18 --subject S18 --manifest <path>/changed-paths.z --skip-gate-summary so the script only consumes the supplied F18..S18 tuple and explicit manifest.

exact_gate_inventory_contract.construction: Before any subprocess invocation, the orchestrator resolves the exact argv for audit01-pytest / audit01-mypy / audit01-ruff and writes the manifest files. The argv tuple is the SAME ordered tuple passed to subprocess.

python_glob_resolution_contract.resolution: Python glob.glob resolves the patterns BEFORE constructing argv. The subprocess argv contains the resolved path tuple, never the literal glob syntax.

act_local_range_contract.explicit_manifest_authority: The orchestrator-supplied changed-paths.z is the SOLE source when --manifest is provided
act_local_range_contract.act_local_no_git_diff_or_status: In explicit range mode act-local MUST NOT invoke git diff, git status, or git ls-files; the orchestrator-supplied manifest is authoritative.
act_local_range_contract.manifest_missing_fails: If --manifest is required but not provided, or if the manifest file is missing, the script must fail closed rather than falling back to Git discovery.

canonical_audit_path_contract.serialized_shard_identity: Each index shard path is its canonical logical file name (basename), independent of a physical root.
canonical_audit_path_contract.physical_resolution: ReportLayout resolves logical identities to physical paths only at read/write boundaries.

lifecycle_stages.stage_1_pre_root_writes: all non-root files exist except final-classification.md and bundle-root.json
lifecycle_stages.stage_2_classification_writes: final-classification.md rendered using ONLY measurements available at that stage (gate_results, bundle_validation, topology from topology.txt, sha256 of every non-root file hashed from disk); bundle_root_sha256 and publication_succeeded are PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESULT
lifecycle_stages.stage_3_root_writes: bundle-root.json hashes referenced files from disk bytes and is independently revalidated
lifecycle_stages.stage_4_atomic_rename: staging directory renamed to fresh final destination
lifecycle_stages.stage_5_publication_result: external publication-result.json outside the bundle records the post-rename measurement
classification_contract.publish_state_in_bundle: READY_TO_PUBLISH or PUBLISHED (set ONLY at stage 4)
classification_contract.publish_state_outside_bundle: Only stage_5 result records success/failure; in-bundle files NEVER claim their own later publication succeeded
classification_contract.external_publication_state: bundle_root_validated: PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESULT before rename; external result is the only authoritative success/failure
classification_contract.final_classification_lifecycle: Stage 2 writes final-classification.md ONCE with PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESULT; subsequent re-renders are NOT allowed; bundle-root.json is NOT an input to classification

publication_contract.inside_bundle: READY_TO_PUBLISH (pre-rename) | PUBLISHED (post-rename, written before the file is read externally)
publication_contract.atomic_boundary: The rename from validated staging directory to fresh final destination is the publication event.

algorithm: reject descendants that are directories, symlinks, special files, or unexpected names
require the exact declared artifact set
hash every regular file EXCEPT bundle-root.json directly from disk bytes (NOT from in-memory authoritative_hashes)
sort by canonical slash-separated relative path
write bundle-root.json without staging/output/temp absolute paths
independently re-enumerate and re-hash every referenced file and confirm zero mismatches
stage_4: only after independent revalidation, rename staging to fresh final destination
stage_5: after rename, rehash the published directory and write external publication-result.json
bundle_root_contract.fresh_destination_check: Before any expensive gate execution, the orchestrator MUST verify the fresh final destination does not exist (assert no stale leftover).

ruff_configuration_contract.canonical_invocation: <launcher> check <exact-subject-python-paths...> (no --config flag, lets Ruff discover pyproject.toml)
ruff_configuration_contract.equivalence: Run both explicit --config and canonical invocations against the identical exact subject Python path tuple; require returncode equality AND normalised_diagnostics_sha256 equality AND ruff_version equality AND input_path_tuple_sha256 equality. No self-comparisons (e.g., x == x) are permitted.
ruff_configuration_contract.independent_measurement_rule: The explicit invocation's diagnostics_sha256 and the canonical invocation's diagnostics_sha256 MUST be derived from SEPARATE subprocess invocations. The function MUST NOT pre-compute a digest and assign it to both records.
ruff_configuration_contract.normalised_diagnostics_rule: Normalised diagnostics include both stdout and stderr concatenated; if Ruff's structured JSON output is available it may be used, otherwise the normalised form is (stdout bytes) || b'\n' || (stderr bytes).
ruff_configuration_contract.on_equivalence_failure: transaction fails; bundle not published; staging removed; nonzero exit

test_inventory_contract.no_collateral_damage: Failing required tests are NOT classified as collateral damage; they must be repaired or explicitly removed with rationale.
